request: Shorten the substitute picker's numbers after exact million-sized Owned counts wrapped their last digit onto a new line.
baseline: Complete Consistent Copy Feedback 20261031 working snapshot and full runnable, not Git HEAD alone
implementation: Shared Need First and Craft Queue substitute picker Owned and Missing labels use comma-decimal rounded k/m/b/t notation, matching existing compact silver: 1100000 -> 1,1m; 1500000 -> 1,5m; 10800 -> 10,8k.
Values below 1000 retain existing quantity formatting, including small fractional values. Non-finite display values show an em dash.
Large count formatting delegates to the existing compact silver formatter; silver behavior itself is unchanged.

One-line quantities retain the Planner typography. Shared numeric columns measure actual formatted labels at the active text scale; constrained layouts retain the existing labeled reflow without shrinking or clipping.
Exact inventory, missing projections, selection, grades, calculations and saved state are unchanged. Existing accessible row descriptions retain full formatted quantities.
Stock and preorder counts remain exact. NPC badges, market freshness, copy/swap actions, drag behavior and theme materials are unchanged. No new hover text or setting.
